body.title: Mediate pinned navigation and optional changed-entity impact
body.summary: Add narrow sc3 source/impact wrappers over s1 reads and s2 trusted receipt admission. Keep identical subject seeds in both modes; only indexed mode receives validated daemon-owned changed-entity caller capability.
acceptanceChecks: Source reads stay pinned, bounded and read-only; trusted inspection receipts support later ledger deltas, not backend-claimed file access.
Caller queries require exact entity membership in selected packet source; ambiguous mapping, stale/missing/partial/empty index results remain explicit unresolved impact.
Impact evidence is context-only with matching native receipt metadata and limits; no additional commits, packets or changed blocks.
Use injected closure-scoped daemon capability, with no DB access in clients or new analyzer recipe; focused source/mode/impact tests pass.

tests.name: Pinned navigation and changed-entity impact scope parity
